nom: Good Molecules 5% Niacinamide Serum with Ectoin

segments.oily: Oily-skin reviewers report the serum absorbs quickly, controls oil, and shrinks pores without greasy residue, though one found it made her skin oily when used without a moisturizer and heavier application.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers describe increased hydration and reduced flaking, especially in winter, with several saying it avoided the stripped feeling they get from stronger niacinamide.
segments.combination: Combination-oily reviewers report better balance, fewer breakouts, and no added irritation.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: many say this is the first niacinamide that doesn't redden or irritate their skin, while a smaller number report new breakouts or irritation shortly after starting.
segments.mature: A small number of mature-skin reviewers report visibly softened forehead lines and reduced age spots.

concerns.aging: Reviewers mention smoother, more refined skin and less visible forehead lines and age spots with continued use.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers report improved hydration and plumper, less tight skin, particularly in dry winter conditions.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers say redness calmed or disappeared with use; one reviewer with acne rosacea reported no irritation but also no major improvement.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers describe a stronger, calmer barrier with less irritation from other actives once this serum was added.
concerns.spots: Reviewers report fewer hyperpigmentation/dark marks and a brighter, more even tone, though one reviewer explicitly saw no change in acne scars.
concerns.blemishes: Most acne-prone reviewers report fewer breakouts, faster resolution of closed comedones, and less noticeable scarring; however, several reviewers report sudden, severe new breakouts including cystic pimples and whiteheads in unusual places after starting.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily or combination skin generally report better oil control and a lightweight, non-greasy finish, but one reviewer felt it made her skin oilier and better suited to use alone without a moisturizer.

aspects.libelle: No pilling under sunscreen or makeup
Bottle size too small for daily use
Sudden severe breakouts on first use

extraits.texte: I've always used a niacinamide on my face from the brand natrium and I took a chance on trying good molecules and considering the reviews I decided to try this product. I used at night and the next morning I woke up with acne so bad, i have never had it looking like this ever in my entire life, ive always had just 1-3 pimples on my face nothing crazy until this. I had new pimples and white heads all over my face even on my eyelids and places I never break out. My forehead, cheeks, chin, jawline, everywhere looks so bad I am not exaggerating. Absolutely terrible. I never write reviews but I had to write one about this product because this is so upsetting.

I have been using this 5% niacinamide serum for 3 weeks now, it has gotten rid of my closed comedones, skin texture, and (most) acne. This + the 10% benzoyl peroxide wash from panoxyl is an amazing duo for acne. The only thing is that if I use 4+ drops my face becomes sort of oily yet slightly glowy, usually my skin's dry. My skin is a lot more hydrated and slightly brighter—as far as hyperpigmentation/acne scars, I haven't noticed a difference with improvement. For reference: I have dry, acne prone, sensitive, uneven skintone type skin. If I see a difference in my acne scars, I will update!

I'm acne prone + dehydrated combination skin. Very clog prone. I found 10% niacinamide to be irritating, I tried this out not realizing what an amazing combination 5% niacinamide is with ectoin & NAG. This helped my skin retain moisture + develop a skin of steel. I use a lot of active in my routine on rotation, as long as I keep this serum in my routine I won't have issues.

This product i cannot beging to express how lucky i am to have found it. My skin is very oily, i breakout easily, and im a pale girly which any blemishes turn bright red. Once i started using this product i noticed my blemishes disappearing, no more breakouts and the redness i had in my face demished so quickly. Ive been persistant with this product for 2 months and if theres a product i can recommend is this one ! Disclaimer, everyones skin is different. I have very sensitive skin but it worked for me.

I have oily, acne-prone skin, and the Good Molecules 5% Niacinamide Serum with Ectoin has been such a lifesaver. Most serums either feel too heavy or cause breakouts, but this one is super lightweight and absorbs quickly without leaving any greasy residue. Since adding it to my routine, my skin feels more balanced—my oiliness is under control, my pores look smaller, and I've had fewer breakouts overall. I've also noticed my skin barrier feels stronger and less irritated, which I think is thanks to this product. It's gentle but effective, and I finally feel like my skin looks healthier and calmer. Definitely a must-have if you deal with excess oil or breakouts!

I bought this serum a few days ago and I'm already noticing a difference on my skin. I have always struggled with acne and dry skin, and even on my best days, my skin has always had texture from closed comedones. I was considering the other niacinamide serum, but I was worried that the 10% would be too much for my dry skin. When I saw this serum had niacinamide at a lower percentage and also had ectoin to help with hydration, I decided to take the chance and purchase it. It has now been a few days since I bought it, and after using it once in the morning and once at night, three drops each time, I can hardly feel any texture on my face. I think my skin is now the smoothest it has ever been since I first started getting acne.

Price point is great. Serum texture is great. I like the glass bottle. Unfortunately, this formula did not work for my skin. I broke out and my skin became irritated and sensitive. I think the concentration of niacinsmide, sadly, doesnt work for my skin.
